messages:
nina: Heads-up: product asked we show per-token and cache-savings breakdown on canary cost cards, otherwise PMs keep missing KV wins. Screenshot attached. :eyes:
omar: Strong yes. We need both tokens_charged and cache_saved_tokens per-variant. Also net_delta_per_1k_invokes for comparability.
sid: Implementation plan: emit a compact snapshot at canary time. POST /internal/v1/snapshots accepts rows: route,variant,invocations,tokens_charged,cache_saved_tokens,token_cost_cents,baseline_snapshot_id,reasons[],approx(boolean). No full timeseries scrape.
ui-bot: mock uploaded: dual stacked bars + per-1k delta toggle.
nina: Product asks an "explain" pill with top reason (model_swap|token_shift|prompt_change) + confidence. Keep heuristics simple so we can explain them.
sid: We'll compute reasons by comparing token median, variant id and prompt overlap, produce confidence from sample size. Mark approx if sample small. We'll sign snapshot blob for audit and keep default retention 90d.
omar: CSV export please. Tooltip with exact cents and token counts.
audit-bot: snapshot signed rollout=canary-2026-03-24T08:00Z
